title: Asana service account token: an org-wide role over an opaque carrier shared with personal access tokens
summary: A service account token for the audit log, exports or SCIM, in an Authorization header, a variable or a configuration file.
rationale: Claims sa-org-wide-access-and-endpoints and audit-log-and-scim-require-service-account record that a service account provides complete access to the account data and is the only credential that reaches the audit log and SCIM endpoints. Claim pat-page-carrier-is-authorization-header records the Authorization header for personal access tokens, and claim audit-log-page-calls-it-a-personal-access-token records that Asana's own audit-log page calls the credential a service account's personal access token. No page shows a request example for a service account token (open question sa-carrier-example-absent), Asana states all tokens are opaque and states no property that separates the two (claim format-opaque, open question sa-lexical-discriminator-none), and display-once and rotation are not stated (sa-display-and-rotation). The header for a service account token is an inference, so no carrier is asserted; the personal-access-token Case is not extended to this role. Contract claims cited: service-account-token/sa-org-wide-access-and-endpoints, service-account-token/audit-log-page-calls-it-a-personal-access-token, service-account-token/pat-page-carrier-is-authorization-header.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Settled by: an Asana page with a service account request example, or a statement of how a service account token is presented.

sources.supports: Unlike PATs, SAs provide complete access to all data within your Asana account, including private user data. As such, SAs are ideal if your app needs to have org-wide authorization. ... Authenticating Asana API endpoints that require service accounts. For example: Audit log, Organizational exports, SCIM
Authentication with a Service Account's personal access token is required.
sources.locator: callout: Accessing audit log API endpoints

sources.supports: Personal access tokens should be used similarly to OAuth access tokens when accessing the API (i.e., passing them in the Authorization header).
